intended_claim: The package faithfully summarizes existing complete-task evidence and implementation boundaries and is sufficient for teacher decision about a possible future main-policy mechanism.
verdict_scope: Evidence-summary and decision-readiness only; not scientific validation of a new mechanism or a general performance claim.
what_results_support: The53 rows preserve three experiments, fixed endpoints and exposed cohorts separately, with parent-equal quality and within-group saved request quantiles.
Current PG/A1 does not establish reliable complete-task improvement over FrozenSL and matched continued supervision on the exposed development evidence.
Integrated historical nonzero effects and P2 failure are retained without describing all RL effects as exactly zero.

Static module claims correctly distinguish the trainable A1 correction from frozen SL, fixed reference, supplied-state guard, raw-dependent deterministic H, automatic service assignment and proxy validation.
The fixed32 branch is faithfully sealed with shared witness32/32, CE14/32, Adam-rank18/32 and QP13/32 and unchanged original resource units.
what_results_dont_support: The proposed trainable main Actor is implemented or effective.
Frozen SL, residual amplitude or guard is the unique cause of missing route gains.
Known-state witness or construction weights are authorized formal initialization or deployment artifacts.
Exposed DEV/SEL establish independent generalization, cross-experiment clocks establish speed superiority, or native raw provides a no-H ablation.
Proxy F&A/navigation validation certifies real IK, joint trajectories or physical execution.
missing_evidence: Reliable DRL complete-task incremental quality against FrozenSL and matched supervision.
Confirmation on previously unexposed parent layouts and varying local scales.
Comparable complete-request quality-time evidence for any future mechanism.
Formal paper-to-evidence claim audit if later used in a manuscript.
suggested_claim_revision: No change required to the package's decision-readiness claim. Keep the main-policy change explicitly unimplemented and awaiting teacher decision, without a root-cause or benefit guarantee.
next_experiments_needed: None executed, authorized, budgeted or designed by this review. Teacher direction selection and separately approved frozen protocol/stage authorization must precede any future scientific work.
provisional_label: provisional — no paper claim audit available
